registered: 2026-08-18, BEFORE the operator is written or run

measured_motivation.why_current_diffusion_cannot_close_it: bounded-confidence diffusion is an AVERAGING operator; every layers/epsilon setting REDUCED extreme mass (0.036 -> 0.026) and worsened W1 (0.3499 -> 0.3600). Averaging cannot manufacture extremes.

mechanism: POLAR interaction: discrete influence events from high-degree hubs push targets TOWARD A POLE (attraction to the source's side), with repulsion when disagreement exceeds a threshold (backfire). Not toward a neighbourhood mean.
protocol: Parameters fit by minimizing Wasserstein-1 on TRAIN countries (2/3, seeded split); every reported number is on HELD-OUT countries. Cell coordinates (age, education) are gate-clean non-benchmark variables.

REGISTERED PREDICTIONS.success: held-out W1 < 0.3499 AND extreme mass rises from 0.036 materially toward 0.647
REGISTERED PREDICTIONS.failure_branch_1: extreme mass rises but held-out W1 worsens => poles are in the wrong places
REGISTERED PREDICTIONS.failure_branch_2: neither moves => polar interaction rejected on this substrate; the constraint is the state space (effective rank 14.6 vs 41.9), not the operator
REGISTERED PREDICTIONS.overfit_guard: train-vs-heldout W1 gap > 0.03 => parameters are fitting country idiosyncrasy, report as such

production_impact: NONE. Flag-gated experiment; production physics untouched; adoption would require a registered build.
